Lee · Listen & Shadow 21

The Call — picking up the phone, asking her out, Saturday
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · CALLING HER
👤 Her
Hello?
여보세요?
hello — 여보세요 (전화)
💬 Lee
Hi, this is Lee — we met at the bar last night.
안녕하세요, 어젯밤 바에서 만난 Lee예요.
this is ~ — (전화에서) ~예요 · last night — 어젯밤
같은 패턴으로 — Hi, this is Lee — we met at the wedding. · Hi, this is Lee from the gallery.
💬 Lee
I hope this isn't a bad time.
지금 통화 괜찮으세요?
a bad time — 곤란한 때
같은 패턴으로 — I hope this isn't too late. · I hope I'm not interrupting.
👤 Her
Sorry, who's this?
누구시죠?
who's this — 누구세요
💬 Lee
Do you remember me? I was the guy with the gin and tonic.
저 기억하세요? 진토닉 마시던 사람이요.
the guy with ~ — ~ 들고 있던 남자
같은 패턴으로 — I was the guy in the blue jacket. · I was the one sitting next to you.
PART 2 · ASKING TO MEET
💬 Lee
Are you free this Saturday?
이번 토요일에 시간 있어요?
free — 시간이 되는
같은 패턴으로 — Are you free tonight? · Are you free next week?
💬 Lee
Would you like to get dinner?
저녁 같이 하실래요?
Would you like to ~? — ~하실래요?
같은 패턴으로 — Would you like to get coffee? · Would you like to come along?
👤 Her
I'm pretty busy this week.
이번 주는 좀 바빠요.
pretty busy — 꽤 바쁜
💬 Lee
How about next week, then?
그럼 다음 주는 어때요?
How about ~? — ~는 어때요?
같은 패턴으로 — How about Sunday instead? · How about a quick lunch?
💬 Lee
No pressure — just let me know.
부담 갖지 마세요 — 편할 때 알려주세요.
no pressure — 부담 갖지 마세요 · let me know — 알려주세요
같은 패턴으로 — No pressure — think about it. · No rush, just let me know.
PART 3 · TIME AND PLACE
💬 Lee
Let's meet at Hongdae station around seven.
홍대입구역에서 7시쯤 만나요.
around ~ — ~쯤
같은 패턴으로 — Let's meet at the café around six. · Let's meet out front around noon.
💬 Lee
I know a good Korean place near there.
거기 근처에 제가 아는 좋은 한식집이 있어요.
place — 가게, 식당
같은 패턴으로 — I know a good coffee place nearby. · I know a quiet bar around the corner.
💬 Lee
I'll text you the address.
주소는 문자로 보낼게요.
text — 문자를 보내다 · address — 주소
같은 패턴으로 — I'll text you the details. · I'll send you the link.
💬 Lee
Great — see you Saturday.
좋아요, 토요일에 봐요.
see you ~ — ~에 봐요
같은 패턴으로 — Great — see you tomorrow. · See you at seven, then.
PART 4 · SATURDAY
💬 Lee
Hey! You made it.
왔네요!
make it — (약속에) 오다
같은 패턴으로 — You made it! · Glad you could make it.
💬 Lee
You look great.
오늘 멋지네요.
look great — 멋져 보이다
같은 패턴으로 — You look nice tonight. · That jacket looks great.
💬 Lee
I'm glad you came.
와줘서 좋아요.
I'm glad ~ — ~해서 좋다
같은 패턴으로 — I'm glad you called. · I'm glad we did this.
💬 Lee
Last night was fun — I'm glad I called.
어젯밤 재밌었어요 — 전화하길 잘했네요.
fun — 재미있는
같은 패턴으로 — Last night was fun — we should do it again. · That trip was fun — I'd go back.
느리게 18/18 · 보통 18/18
